title: Give an agent a video avatar
summary: Three ai.params, video_idle_file, video_listening_file and video_talking_file, give an agent a face on a video call. The platform switches between the three clips with the agent's state.
scenario: A bike shop's video front desk that shows a face rather than a blank tile

folds: demo santa, cinebot, bobbystable, example (avatar files)
evidence: schema.json AIParams: video_idle_file, video_listening_file, video_talking_file, each 'Only works for calls that support video.'
sdk core/mixins/ai_config_mixin.py set_params merges into ai.params
